reason: A DSH plugin update manager that monitors installed packages and profiles, summarizes available changes, and performs explicitly confirmed plugin updates through supported npm, GitHub, and linked-checkout paths.

summaries.zh: 用于 DeepSeek Harness 的更新助手，可扫描各配置中的插件版本与变更信息，并在明确确认后执行插件更新。
summaries.en: An update assistant for DeepSeek Harness that scans plugin versions and change information across profiles and performs plugin updates only after explicit confirmation.

capabilities: Scans installed DSH core bundles and profile plugins for npm and Git updates
Retrieves version, commit, changelog, and release information from registries and upstream repositories
Executes confirmed plugin updates through the DSH plugin CLI
Pulls linked Git checkouts and manages temporary stashes during updates
Switches linked dependencies to remote npm or GitHub sources when explicitly confirmed
